options.name: algorithm
options.description: Algorithm to generate the key.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: autorollover
options.description: Flag to enable/disable key rollover automatically. Note: * Key name will be appended with _AR1 for successor key. For e.g. current key=k1, successor key=k1_AR1. * Key name can be truncated if current name length is more than 58 bytes to accomodate the suffix.

options.name: expires
options.description: Time period for which to consider the key valid, after the key is used to sign a zone.

options.name: filenameprefix
options.description: Common prefix for the names of the generated public and private key files and the Delegation Signer (DS) resource record. During key generation, the .key, .private, and .ds suffixes are appended automatically to the file name prefix to produce the names of the public key, the private key, and the DS record, respectively.

options.name: keyname
options.description: Name of the public-private key pair to publish in the zone.

options.name: keysize
options.description: Size of the key, in bits.

options.name: keytype
options.description: Type of key to create.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: notificationperiod
options.description: Time at which to generate notification of key expiration, specified as number of days, hours, or minutes before expiry. Must be less than the expiry period. The notification is an SNMP trap sent to an SNMP manager. To enable the appliance to send the trap, enable the DNSKEY-EXPIRY SNMP alarm.  In case autorollover option is enabled, rollover for successor key will be intiated at this time. No notification trap will be sent.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: password
options.description: Passphrase for reading the encrypted public/private DNS keys

options.name: privatekey
options.description: File name of the private key.

options.name: publickey
options.description: File name of the public key.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: revoke
options.description: Revoke the key. Note: This operation is non-reversible.

options.name: rollovermethod
options.description: Method used for automatic rollover. * Key type: ZSK, Method: C(PrePublication) or C(DoubleSignature). * Key type: KSK, Method: C(DoubleRRSet).

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: src
options.description: URL (protocol, host, path, and file name) from where the DNS key file will be imported. NOTE: The import fails if the object to be imported is on an HTTPS server that requires client certificate authentication for access. This is a mandatory argument

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(created), the `create` operation will be applied on the resource. When C(imported), the resource will be imported on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Time to Live (TTL), in seconds, for the DNSKEY resource record created in the zone. TTL is the time for which the record must be cached by the DNS proxies. If the TTL is not specified, either the DNS zone's minimum TTL or the default value of 3600 is used.

options.name: units1
options.description: Units for the expiry period.

options.name: units2
options.description: Units for the notification period.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: zonename
options.description: Name of the zone for which to create a key.
